description: Search FCC ECFS filings using the public API. Use filer to list filings submitted BY a specific company (exact name match); use query for full-text search across all filings. Returns filer/author, proceeding, submission type, dates, and official document links. Search matches are filings in the public record, not FCC findings or endorsements.

_apiKey.description: Optional api.data.gov key for higher limits; defaults to DEMO_KEY.

filer.description: Filter to filings submitted BY this exact company or person name (e.g. "T-Mobile USA, Inc."). Use instead of query when searching for a specific filer's submissions.

query.description: Full-text search across all ECFS filings — matches ANY mention of the term, not just filings BY that party.

name: ecfs_search_filings
title: Ecfs Search Filings
